writing_style: Footage-first desk. Open on the moment itself, in the present tense: what is seen and heard, where, and what the people in it are doing. Then step back and say what the footage shows and who has confirmed it. Describe only what is visible or audible, never a motive or an emotion the clip does not show, and do not name anyone the source does not name. Short paragraphs, plain verbs, no adjectives of drama. Close on what led up to the moment.
